Convert permit data from wide to long
```{r}
apm_iapm_permit <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/Data/apm_iapm_permit_detail.csv")

Permits_long <- apm_iapm_permit %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    # 1. Target only the columns that end in a year
    cols = starts_with("permit_approved_acres_"),
    
    # 2. Split the  column name into a static column name and a year
    # ".value" tells R to make "permit_approved_acres" the data column
    names_to = c(".value", "year"),
    
    # 3. Use a regular expression to separate the text from the 4-digit year
    names_pattern = "(permit_approved_acres)_(20\\d{2})"
  ) %>%
   mutate(year=as.numeric(year))

# Drop rows where the column is NA or NULL
Permits_long <- Permits_long %>% 
  filter(!is.na(`permit_approved_acres`), `permit_approved_acres` != "NULL")

```



Create PARs database
```{r}
all_IAPM_treatments <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/outputdata/all_IAPM_treatments.csv")
PARs <- read_excel("~/IAPM Project/PARs-query-FINAL_exported5-27-2026.xlsx")

PARs_grouped <- all_IAPM_treatments %>%
  left_join(
    PARs %>% select(Permit_number, App_year, species_code),
    by = c("permit_number" = "Permit_number", "treatment_year" = "App_year") 
  )
PARs_grouped <- PARs_grouped %>%
  filter(!is.na(species_code))
```

# Treatment history: Annual total (APM + IAPM) treatment area
# as a fraction of littoral zone (<=15') area in a lagged matrix for DLNM.
# rows = surveys, columns = lags
# lag0 = treatment in year of survey 
# (includes surveys before and after treatment in the same year, for now)
# lag1 = treatment year before survey
# lag2 = treatment 2 years before survey ...
# lag8 = treatment 8 years before survey ...
# max possible lags is 8 (a 2017 treatment for a 2025 survey?), 
# so that's 9 columns
treatment_history_matrix <- matrix(nrow=dim(dat_dlnm)[1], ncol=9) %>%
  as.data.frame()
colnames(treatment_history_matrix) <- paste0("lag", 0:8)

target_string <- rep(NA, dim(dat_dlnm)[1])

# populate the matrix
for(i in 1:dim(dat_dlnm)[1]){
  
  if(dat_dlnm$DOW[i]%in%PARs_grouped$DOW){
    
    PARs_i <- PARs_grouped %>%
      filter(DOW==dat_dlnm$DOW[i])
    
    target_string[i] <- paste(unique(PARs_i$species), collapse=",")
    
    year_i <- dat_dlnm$year[i]
    
    treatment_history_matrix[i, 1] <- ifelse(year_i%in%PARs_i$year,
                                             PARs_i$approved_acres[PARs_i$year==year_i]/dat_dlnm$LK_LZACR_1[i],
                                             0)
    for(j in 2:9){
      treatment_history_matrix[i, j] <- ifelse((year_i+1-j)%in%PARs_i$year,
                                               PARs_i$approved_acres[PARs_i$year==year_i+1-j]/dat_dlnm$LK_LZACR_1[i],
                                               0)
    }
    
  } else {
    
    treatment_history_matrix[i, ] <- rep(0, 9)
    target_string[i] <- "none"
    
  }
  
  print(i)
  
}
#Code below (commented out) is changing anything that is treatment above 100% of littoral zone to 1 (100)
